project_type: Python 3.12 Flask SAR Workbench with stdlib-only MCP client/server, SQLite/PostgreSQL persistence, RDKit, and vanilla browser JavaScript
build_system: Pixi-pinned runtime; no separate build step. Application routes are in app.py, domain engines are top-level modules, MCP package is sar_mcp/.
test_framework: pytest 8.4.1 via Pixi; baseline pixi run test has 200 passing tests; MCP unit/integration baseline has 33 passing tests.
build_command: No compile/build command; use pixi run test and the focused pytest selectors.
verification_instructions: Run focused selectors after each feature, then pixi run test. Use pixi run mcp-check only against an existing configured loopback app; do not restart it. Do not claim browser/Kiro UI verification unless executed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: No generated source snapshots are expected. Tests may create temporary SQLite databases/uploads. Preserve test/CellLinePanel_pIC50s.xlsx and generated CSVs.
environment_constraints: Work directly in /Users/yipy/Documents/GitHub/SAR_tool; no worktree, commit, push, reset, or destructive cleanup. Keep read-only/analyze/full modes and browser-only human governance. Do not expose credentials, CSRF/session tokens, raw workbook/base64 bytes, raw pair text, SQL, or untrusted notes.
contribution_requirements: README.md, pixi.toml, mcp-roadmap requirements/design/review artifacts are authoritative. Existing database transaction, Flask authorization/CSRF, import quarantine, shaping, and link conventions must be reused. No new dependency is expected.
key_patterns: MCP tools are registered through sar_mcp/tools.py and Tool records; tiers are read/analyze/write; SarClient is the only HTTP path; app.py is authorization/transaction boundary; import_formats.py is a dependency-free safe XLSX reader; prodrug_engine.py is explicit project-local mapping source of truth; browser Compare uses endpoint_a/endpoint_b/stage/coverage/q/selected and endpoint_b=none.
directory_structure: Top-level Flask app/domain engines and migrations/ contain persistence; sar_mcp/ contains MCP contracts/client/tools; static/ and templates/ contain production UI; tests/ contains pytest suites; .agents/tasks/ contains planning artifacts; test/ contains user-provided workbook and generated data.
